blurb: Francisco Grande Hotel and Golf Resort This par 72 Ralph Plummer traditional designed layout features lush fairways, mature trees, well-manicured greens, and three abundant lakes. The desert-framed course is one of the longest in the state at 7,545 yards and is adjustable to 5,200 yards to make it both challenging and fun for all skill
